## 30 - Escalate to Team
Claims the handoff once (a second message cannot hand off twice), posts the transcript to Slack, saves the Slack thread and emails the team with reply-to set to the customer. A message after the handoff goes into the same Slack thread. Test runs (dry run) build everything but send nothing.

// Return Already: another message handed this chat off first, so nothing is sent twice.
return [{ json: { claimed: false, already_handed_off: true, dry_run: !!$('Config').first().json.dry_run } }];
